title: No DATABASE.md
description: The Commander expectations and the source state that the product uses no database. The log is read-only file input, so there is no persistent state for a DATABASE.md contract.
system_choice: Omit DATABASE.md. No persistence stack is selected, and no story implements DATABASE.md.

title: RPT-008 owned by a separate story
description: RPT-008 applies to every report, so it cannot be cleanly attached to one report story. It is owned by report-empty-match, which depends on all six report stories and verifies and corrects their empty-match output.
system_choice: Keep empty-match behavior in report-empty-match, after the six report stories.

title: BLD-001 separate from the foundation
description: Foundational stories may not carry covers or accepts. BLD-001 is an analyzed behavior, so it is owned by a service story, build-entry, that depends on go-foundation.
system_choice: Keep go-foundation as a foundational story with no covers or accepts, and assign BLD-001 to build-entry.

title: Start date from a short or malformed started_at
description: The source defines the start date as the first 10 characters of started_at but does not say what happens when that text is shorter than 10 characters or is not a date. No skip rule covers it.
system_choice: Use the first min(10, length) characters as the date text. Do not skip the record. This keeps the skip rules limited to the source's stated rules.

title: Go module path
description: The source does not name a module path.

title: Analysis story count differs from enumerated IDs
description: ANALYSIS.md metadata reports 22 stories, but its Story List enumerates 21 IDs: LOG 5, FLT 2, RPT 8, CLI 4, BLD 2. The topology covers all 21 enumerated IDs.
system_choice: Treat the enumerated Story List as authoritative. Cover all 21 IDs with exactly one story each.

title: Acceptance skipped: log-decode-ignores-blank
system_choice: Leave log-decode-ignores-blank untested until its acceptance setup is repaired; do not treat it as passed.
